records.title: German embassy address with Bussche signature
records.header_literal: A) YZ v LP (6.11 a.m., November 8th); FUER YZ 2200 (7/11) [2/3] TLE; 1 TL RICHI-84
records.meaning: An address to the German embassy and a Bussche signature. The transmitted place-name lacks the second N of Konstantinopel and is preserved as Konstantiopel.
notes: The two proposed ordinary-word repairs change DERTSCHE to DEUTSCHE and KSNSTANTIOPEL to KONSTANTIOPEL. The missing N is not inserted into the plaintext or the source.

The overstruck second character in the third group of source row 2 is transcribed X in the primary VXXVX reading. A V alternative, VVXVX, is retained independently; the alternative changes the raw H in DERTSCHE to X and does not establish a different historical message.

The heading advertises a multipart message; its faint part-count digit admits 2/3 readings, retained explicitly. Only the first part is printed in this section. The Bussche signature is not expanded to a named historical person.

The bracketed [2/3] in the header is a transcription ambiguity, not a literal bracketed source field. Enlarged comparison with the same-page 1835 and 2TLE type remains inconclusive across reviewers. Both alternatives are retained; neither changes the advertised 84-coordinate body length or the cipher analysis.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.

parallel_address_witness.scope: Compare the common address/signature formula only. Headers differ, p158 A2 has a literal UPK3 prefix, and none of this establishes identical missing bodies or a reception/copy mechanism. No additional physical record is counted.
